purpose: Preserve the useful Wave 3 foundation while explicitly separating capabilities that survive unchanged from those that must be reframed, replaced, deferred or retired under the Places, Reporting & Civic Participation model.

dispositionDefinitions.KEEP: Capability purpose survives unchanged. Existing implementation is preserved unless later integration work is needed.
dispositionDefinitions.REFRAME: Capability remains useful but its user job, ownership or presentation changes under the Place Registry/task-led model.
dispositionDefinitions.REPLACE: The old interaction/model itself is superseded by a different mechanism.
dispositionDefinitions.DEFER: Capability remains valid but should be executed only after redesigned workflows stabilize or governance/data prerequisites exist.
dispositionDefinitions.RETIRE: Capability is no longer needed and has no successor.

crossCuttingRetirements.concept: Generic star-style civic asset ratings as a primary participation mechanism
crossCuttingRetirements.replacement: Structured, dated observations tied to useful place conditions

crossCuttingRetirements.concept: Civic Map as the owner of canonical place/asset data
crossCuttingRetirements.replacement: Shared Place Registry consumed by Civic Map, BetterBarangay, Services, Mobility, Search, Visit/Heritage and other relevant surfaces
crossCuttingRetirements.successor: W3R-2a to W3R-3d and W3R-9a to W3R-9e

crossCuttingRetirements.concept: Public participation success measured mainly through submission/rating volume
crossCuttingRetirements.replacement: Outcome-oriented case, observation and audit metrics with publication thresholds

crossCuttingRetirements.concept: Requiring users to search for an asset before reporting a local problem

capabilities.capability: Distinguish official participation from BetterMakati community input
capabilities.reason: Preserve the distinction between official government participation and BetterMakati community input.

capabilities.capability: Task-led entry points for reporting, suggestions, corrections, sources, volunteering and official participation
capabilities.reason: Keep task-led entry, but replace Civic Map-centric choices with report a local problem, suggest a place improvement, help document Makati, corrections/sources, BetterMakati ideas and volunteering.

capabilities.capability: Each participation choice routes to a functional destination
capabilities.reason: Functional routing remains required, but several destinations will change as reporting, observations and civic audits are redesigned.

capabilities.capability: Carry BetterBarangay context into participation actions
capabilities.reason: Barangay context remains useful across reporting, place discovery, corrections, proposals and audits.

capabilities.capability: Show current official consultations, hearings, assemblies and similar opportunities
capabilities.reason: Current official participation opportunities remain a distinct useful user job; source incompleteness stays an explicit data limitation.

capabilities.capability: Dedicated mobile/accessibility QA for the participation hub
capabilities.reason: Run dedicated mobile/accessibility QA only after the redesigned participation surfaces stabilize.

capabilities.capability: Useful issue and improvement categories
capabilities.reason: Issue and improvement taxonomies remain useful, but must be simplified around task-led reporting and separated from structured condition observations.

capabilities.capability: Functional report/proposal/review/update form
capabilities.reason: The combined report/proposal/rating-review/update interaction is too broad. Preserve reports, proposals and updates in redesigned flows; replace rating/review with structured observations.

capabilities.capability: Barangay, asset, point/segment and long-street geographic handling
capabilities.reason: Move geographic identity from Civic Map-owned assets into the shared Place Registry and add nearby-place matching so users need not find assets manually.

capabilities.capability: Keep emergency cases out of BetterMakati and route immediately to the appropriate emergency channel
capabilities.reason: Immediate-danger cases must continue to bypass BetterMakati case submission and route to 911 or the appropriate emergency channel.

capabilities.capability: Detect and consolidate likely duplicate public-realm cases
capabilities.reason: Duplicate detection is directly useful for place-based reporting and should carry into the redesigned flow.

capabilities.capability: Clear post-submission confirmation and tracking
capabilities.reason: Public confirmation/tracking remains important after any report or proposal submission.

capabilities.capability: Meaningful citywide Civic Map asset coverage
capabilities.reason: Replace 'Civic Map coverage' with Place Registry coverage. The 88 verified assets become shared website infrastructure used by multiple surfaces.

capabilities.capability: Distinct lifecycle states from community submission through resolution
capabilities.reason: The case lifecycle remains valid independently of Civic Map: reviewed, forwarded, acknowledged, action reported and community-verified resolved.

capabilities.capability: Store lifecycle events with destination/channel/reference evidence
capabilities.reason: Destination, channel, reference, evidence and timestamp fields remain necessary for credible case tracking.

capabilities.capability: Present meaningful public lifecycle status without overstating government action
capabilities.reason: Public status must continue to distinguish BetterMakati/community evidence from documented government action.

capabilities.capability: Require human review before referral to government
capabilities.reason: Human review remains necessary before referral to avoid wrong jurisdiction, weak evidence and false claims of official receipt.

capabilities.capability: Automatic delivery of eligible cases to government channels
capabilities.reason: Automatic forwarding remains inappropriate until destination, authorization, evidence and accountability rules are reliable.

capabilities.capability: Page-specific correction path
capabilities.reason: Page-specific correction remains a useful generic BetterMakati contribution path.

capabilities.capability: General idea/proposal submission
capabilities.reason: General BetterMakati ideas/proposals remain useful; place-specific improvements will be separated into the place workflow.

capabilities.capability: Submit a public source or record
capabilities.reason: Submitting public records and source links remains useful across the whole site.

capabilities.capability: Deduplicate general corrections, ideas and source submissions
capabilities.reason: General feedback deduplication has since been implemented and remains valuable.

capabilities.capability: Concrete contribution paths instead of generic civic-engagement copy
capabilities.reason: Keep concrete actions but add civic-audit participation and align public-place actions with the redesigned reporting/observation model.

capabilities.capability: Native BetterMakati submission with transparent public tracking
capabilities.reason: Native submission with transparent public tracking remains the preferred general-input path.

capabilities.capability: Submission fallback when native storage is unavailable
capabilities.reason: Fallback must remain available when native submission storage is unavailable.

capabilities.capability: Relevant BetterLGU/OpenBayan participation handoffs
capabilities.reason: BetterLGU/OpenBayan and other relevant ecosystem handoffs remain useful for out-of-scope journeys.

capabilities.capability: Barangay-scoped public-realm participation
capabilities.reason: Replace 'barangay-scoped Civic Map' as the main concept with barangay places, local issues, improvements, audit campaigns and official contact.

capabilities.capability: Surface barangay government contact near participation actions
capabilities.reason: Local official contact remains useful alongside reports, improvements and participation.

capabilities.capability: Carry barangay context into general source/correction/proposal forms
capabilities.reason: Barangay context should continue into source/correction/proposal forms; this gap has already been implemented.

capabilities.capability: Barangay-specific issue/activity summaries based on real submissions
capabilities.reason: Replace sparse map-activity summaries with evidence-based local issues, improvements, place conditions and audit coverage as data becomes available.

capabilities.capability: Simple public participation counts by recent period
capabilities.reason: Raw recent counts may remain useful, but the feedback loop should emphasize meaningful case/observation/audit outcomes rather than volume for its own sake.

capabilities.capability: Separate community resolution signals from verified lifecycle resolution
capabilities.reason: Community resolution signals must remain distinct from documented lifecycle resolution.

capabilities.capability: Weekly/monthly public participation synthesis
capabilities.reason: Keep synthesis only if it explains meaningful issues, actions, conditions or audit findings; retire rating-centric summaries.

capabilities.capability: Measure response time, conversion and outcomes across all BetterMakati participation channels
capabilities.reason: Measure useful outcomes across redesigned workflows: location matching, review, routing, acknowledgement, action, resolution, freshness, audit coverage and repeat contribution.

capabilities.capability: Publish headline popularity/engagement metrics before enough observations exist
capabilities.reason: Continue withholding representative-looking rates/scores when sample size, recency or coverage is insufficient.

capabilities.capability: Basic browser coverage for Civic Map participation journeys
capabilities.reason: Retain useful baseline tests, but final public-place coverage must test nearby reporting, place matching, observations and lifecycle rather than the old ratings-first flow.

capabilities.capability: Human page-audit coverage for every major participation surface
capabilities.reason: Audit the stabilized redesigned participation/place surfaces rather than moving targets.

capabilities.capability: End-to-end browser tests for POST submission, fallback, tracking and lifecycle transitions
capabilities.reason: E2E submission/fallback/tracking coverage remains required but should be finalized after redesigned workflows stabilize.

capabilities.capability: Dedicated mobile, keyboard, label, focus and error-state QA across the participation journey
capabilities.reason: Run the dedicated mobile, keyboard, focus, label and error-state pass against the redesigned experience.

capabilities.capability: Avoid unnecessary personal data and warn against sensitive submissions
capabilities.reason: Continue minimizing personal data and warning against sensitive submissions across all redesigned contribution paths.

nextStep.title: Define shared Place Registry schema
nextStep.maximumScope: Schema/design record only. Define canonical place fields, lifecycle/provenance relationships and which fields remain participation-specific. No code migration.
